name: Priyaan Thakkar
bio: One of FLAME's most consistent competitors, Priyaan won the NMIMS Fury Tournament and finished 1st on the Squash Ladder (Edition 3). A strategic player with exceptional court coverage and composure under pressure.

name: Maanvir Kamani
bio: A powerful and technically sound player, Maanvir reached the pre-quarterfinals at NMIMS Fury and finished 2nd on the Squash Ladder. Known for his aggressive baseline game and relentless fitness.

name: Avi Sharma
bio: A dynamic all-round player who balances leadership with competitive squash. Avi brings energy to every match and is known for his quick reflexes and attacking style of play.

name: Japman Singh Bhasin
bio: A technically gifted player who reached the quarterfinals at the NMIMS Fury Tournament. Japman is known for his precise shot-making and ability to grind out tough matches.

name: Shahaan Singh Anand
bio: A seasoned player with strong court sense and experience. Shahaan is a reliable presence on the team and brings composure to high-pressure inter-college matches.

name: Dhwani Balchandani
bio: President of the FLAME Squash Club and a top-ranked player, finishing 3rd on the Squash Ladder. Dhwani leads by example both on and off the court, combining competitive excellence with strong club leadership.

name: Riya Girish
role: Head of Social Media & Team Player
bio: A determined and skillful player who competes with intensity and consistency. Riya balances her role as Social Media Head with strong on-court performances throughout the season.

name: Adhya Bamrah
bio: A swift and agile player known for her movement and retrieval skills. Adhya has been a consistent performer in both intra and inter-college competitions throughout the year.
